mechanics.claim: Inner Flame explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing damage to nearby enemies and slowing them.
mechanics.quote: fires a bolt in the target direction that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and briefly {{tip|slow|slowing}} them

mechanics.claim: The slow is 40% for 1.5 seconds (utility, does not affect damage in a stationary-dummy fight).
Spell shield blocks the initial Inner Flame impact.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the initial impact from ''Inner Flame''.

mechanics.claim: The ability can be cast (fires) only at the end of the cast time, i.e. damage happens after a delay from cast.
With Mantra, Inner Flame also fires a larger bolt that explodes at max range, dealing increased damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Inner Flame'' deals increased damage, and fires a larger bolt that also explodes at maximum range.

mechanics.claim: The Soulflare explosion creates a field that later ruptures to deal separate magic damage after the initial impact damage.
mechanics.quote: The explosion creates a field for {{fd|1.5}} seconds that {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies within by 50%, which then ruptures to deal {{as|magic damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks the initial impact from either ability but not Soulflare's field damage, meaning the field damage is a separate, unblockable-by-shield instance.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the initial impact from either ability but will not block ''Soulflare's'' field damage.
